levels.surface: سعيد بن يسار مولى بني النجار

notes: «بإسناده مثله» : a back reference to the earlier isnad of this chain; no previous report is supplied in the context, so it stays as written
«قال فقلت يا أمه إن هذا حدثني أن النبي ...» is a first-person narrative whose transmitter «هذا» is not named (rule 11)
«وقال فيه سعيد بن يسار» names another transmitter for the saying: a variant, not a route
